_comment: Remote GPU build lane rows (carbon/reconstruction/remote_gpu_build.py): "<challenge> <version>": {"device_kind": <the ONE rented GPU variant, exactly as nvidia-smi names it>, "slots": N (optional, default 1, at most 4)}.
